newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Parliament's lower Chamber of Deputies rejected an opposition Party of Social Democracy (PDSR) motion which slammed Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea for holding on his job as Bucharest mayor despite taking over the premiership.
The PDSR accused Ciorbea of breaching the constitution and asked for early elections for Bucharest mayor.
The motion was rejected with a score of 180 to 106.
* The Senate elected judge Paul Mitroi, National Liberal Party nominee, as Romania's first ombudsman, for a four-year term.

* The BNS trade union federation criticised the government for failing to stick to the terms of pre-electoral accord struck between the BNS and the Democratic Convention. The BNS threatened to call protest rallies against dropping living standards starting June 11.

* The six coal miners who were taken to a hospital in Timisoara after Monday's gas explosion in a Jiu Valley mine were still in a critical condition, hospital authorities said. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264 REUTER
